anchor_n7.title: N7
anchor_n7.quote: He was so fat he looked like a building code violation.
anchor_n7.description: The orange cat Nova found when she was seven. She says her naming sense was never any good.

anchor_goodnight.title: Good Night
anchor_goodnight.description: The first real farewell — not the end of a transmission, but the beginning of a connection.

anchor_observatory.title: Observation Room
anchor_observatory.quote: No matter how vast the universe is, it will never answer you
anchor_observatory.description: The place Nova stays most often — and the place she feels most alone.

anchor_white_flower.title: Little White Flower
anchor_white_flower.quote: It shouldn't have survived. But it still bloomed.
anchor_white_flower.description: A flower that grew inside a maintenance air duct. Nova never reported it, because it was “trying very hard.”

anchor_milk_candy.title: Milk Candy
anchor_milk_candy.quote: Thinking about it still feels warm
anchor_milk_candy.description: A piece of Nova's childhood memory — later an anchor that could reawaken residual feeling.

anchor_maintenance_board.title: Cosmic-Level Threat
anchor_maintenance_board.quote: Behold — a threat of cosmic proportions
anchor_maintenance_board.description: A maintenance board the engineering team lost. Someone stuck two eyes on it.

anchor_steak.title: Research Incident
anchor_steak.quote: Don't ask. Let's just call it a research incident.
anchor_steak.description: Synthetic steak from the Aurora mess hall. Nova suspects it is closer to building material.
